scripts.generate:sepolia: NETWORK=sepolia node scripts/generate-contract-names.js && NETWORK=sepolia node scripts/generate-addresses.js && npm run generate
scripts.prepublish:sepolia: rimraf build generated && graph codegen && npm run generate:sepolia && graph build --network sepolia
scripts.publish:sepolia:patch: npm run prepublish:sepolia && npm run bump:sepolia:patch && npm run redeploy:sepolia
scripts.publish:sepolia:minor: npm run prepublish:sepolia && npm run bump:sepolia:minor && npm run redeploy:sepolia
scripts.publish:sepolia:major: npm run prepublish:sepolia && npm run bump:sepolia:major && npm run redeploy:sepolia
scripts.generate:demo: NETWORK=sepolia NETWORKS_FILE=networks.demo.json node scripts/generate-contract-names.js && NETWORK=sepolia NETWORKS_FILE=networks.demo.json node scripts/generate-addresses.js && npm run generate
scripts.prepublish:demo: rimraf build generated && graph codegen && npm run generate:demo && graph build --network sepolia --network-file networks.demo.json
scripts.deploy:demo: graph deploy --node http://localhost:18020/ --ipfs https://api.thegraph.com/ipfs/ --version-label $(jq -r '.sepolia' versions.json) --network sepolia --network-file networks.demo.json sandbox-demo
scripts.publish:demo:patch: npm run prepublish:demo && npm run bump:sepolia:patch && npm run deploy:demo
scripts.publish:demo:minor: npm run prepublish:demo && npm run bump:sepolia:minor && npm run deploy:demo
scripts.publish:demo:major: npm run prepublish:demo && npm run bump:sepolia:major && npm run deploy:demo
